bindings: R2 read, Cache API at edges
verdict: Strong offload candidate on expensive cache misses. Photon and jSquash process typed image buffers; all heavy work is library Wasm. No direct scriptc target. Deployment instructions and Worker handler exist, but no checked-in Wrangler config was found.

Strong offload candidate for large transforms. Photon Lanczos3 plus Wasm codecs; source guards large rasters against Worker heap exhaustion. A Node codec replacement is needed, not promotion of the tiny parameter helpers.

bindings: Cache API at Worker edge; container routing binding
verdict: Already offloaded. Worker selects a PhotonContainer and forwards the request; Rust/Actix fetches, decodes, transforms and encodes. Concrete architectural precedent, not evidence of scriptc savings.

bindings: Cache API and origin fetch at edges
verdict: Strong offload candidate for large cache misses, implemented in Rust/Wasm already. README reports large images exhausting the then-current CPU budget. Historical limits there are not current platform limits.

bindings: No env bindings; assets loaded by rendering library
verdict: Conditional candidate. ImageResponse delegates layout and rasterization to workers-og. README says about two seconds, without separating CPU from asset I/O or cold start. No numeric JS hot loop demonstrated.

bindings: D1 auth/usage and Cache API at edges; font/image fetch before render
verdict: Conditional candidate, especially batch up to 20 images. Satori layout plus resvg rasterization. Timings use Date.now and svgMs includes asset fetching, so advertised time is not CPU evidence. Hot renderer uses imported Wasm, not promotable JS loops.

license: MIT stated in README; no LICENSE file
route: Service-binding RPC image(html, options); HTTP fetch is 404
bindings: Font Cache API and asset fetches can stay at edges
verdict: Conditional service workload, not a public image HTTP route. Satori and resvg are separable after fonts load. An explicit container HTTP shim must replace WorkerEntrypoint RPC; HTML parsing is string-heavy.

bindings: Font loading can be done before render
verdict: Conditional candidate and framework integration example, not an independent production app. adapter-cloudflare config is checked in. Runtime rendering invokes Satori/resvg or Takumi Wasm; pre-rendered variants and client-side examples are excluded.

Strong offload candidate for memory-hard hashing. Rust Argon2 dominates; password plus options form a small input. Native library/service port is required. Salt generation makes hash nondeterministic, so shadow verification cannot compare hash bytes. Verify is the cleaner deterministic comparison. No end-to-end timing measured.

bindings: Analytics Engine queries, auth, ingestion bindings
verdict: Reject for numeric offload. SQL service performs aggregation; Worker fills time buckets and maps records to chart data. Numeric-looking analytics is mainly remote work and object/date processing. React Router Cloudflare adapter and Wrangler config prove deployment support.

bindings: R2 byte-range reads through PMTiles Source throughout retrieval
verdict: Reject. Serves existing tiles, does not generate or render them. Header/directory decode and decompression do not establish tens of ms of numeric JS work. A callback for each range read would move I/O into the offload path.
